The plate is a square plate, roughly 22-26 cm across. It holds scrambled eggs, about 1/2 to 2/3 of a cup, or roughly 3 eggs' worth at about 120-150 g. It also holds broccoli, about 80-100 g.

Eggs: 140 g at about 1.5 kcal/g, plus cooking fat, comes to about 210-230 kcal. The eggs look cheesy and bright yellow, so I'll say 230 kcal.

Broccoli: 90 g at 0.35 kcal/g is about 32 kcal. It looks sautéed in a little oil, so I'll add roughly 30 kcal, for about 60 kcal.

Total: about 290 kcal, with a mass of about 230 g.
